# <span id="aanchor198"></span> Ticket Details Editor

The Ticket Editor is used for entering data for a ticket that is not assigned to a meter. All fields with a green background such as Date, Device Number, and Product must be populated prior to saving data.

When a ticket is initially created or is opened from the Ticket Editor or Ticket Search screen, the Ticket Editor Detail is displayed. The appearance of this form differs between ticket types, but most sections (segregated by tabs) are shared between ticket types.

<div class="procedure">

To edit ticket details:

1.  Double-click a ticket in the [Ticket Editor](../Ticket%20Editor.md). The Ticket Details Editor window will display.
2.  Complete all required data.
3.  Enter the ticket number to be used for this ticket. A **Regenerate Ticket Number** button 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> is located next to the Ticket Number entry field when the [Generate Ticket Number At](../../Settings%20Manager/Application/FLOWCAL%20Configuration.md#Generate) configuration option is set to "Save".
4.  Select a ticket type. Onscreen options will vary by ticket type. If ticket creation has been initiated from the Ticket Editor, the ticket type will reflect the ticket type section that was open when the ticket was created.
5.  If the device type is set to "Location", you will need to select a location to assign the ticket to. If this is not known or there is not one, set the device type to "Standalone".
6.  Complete all applicable fields.
7.  When you are ready to save, select an edit reason and click **Save**.
8.  If you need to make changes to the data, click **Edit**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 549;height: 448;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Ticket Details Editor screen:

- **Date** - This is the ticket's effective date and determines when the measurement specified by the ticket will be accounted for.
- **Ticket Number** - This field serves as a means of identifying and tracking a ticket. Depending on the options set under the FLOWCAL application options, this identifier may be automatically generated by FLOWCAL, brought in by import, or manually entered.
- **GMS Date** - This field stores the date and time at which the latest revision of a ticket was generated.
- **Revision** - Whenever an edit is made to a ticket, a revision is generated, and it is here that the current revision number of a ticket is indicated. Clicking Show Revisions will bring up a screen showing the results for each revision of the ticket.
- **Status** - This field displays a ticket's current status. The status will be either "Empty" or "Closed".
- **Ticket Type** - This field displays the ticket type of a selected ticket. Once a ticket has been created, its type cannot be changed. The type may only be explicitly chosen when a ticket is created using the Ticket Search form; within the ticket editor, a ticket's type is determined by the tab from which its creation was initiated.
- **Product** - A product associated with a ticket's measurement must be specified when the ticket is created.
- **Device Type** - The user may specify whether a ticket belongs to a Location or if it is Standalone and associated with no location. If a ticket is attached to a location, its measured values will be accounted for within that location. Certain ticket-types (such as Tank Run and Tank Gauge) cannot be created as Standalone.
- **Device Number** - The displays the Device Number associated with a ticket. For location-attached tickets, this field will display the Location Number of the location to which the ticket belongs.
- **Class & Direction** - These fields serve to classify the type of measurement represented by a ticket. If the Subtotal by Direction or Subtotal by Class options have been set under the FLOWCAL Application Options, the class and direction specified for a ticket will determine how the ticket's data will be accounted for within a location with respect to the other members of that location.
- **Rejected** - When loading product onto a rail car or a truck, there may be times when the vehicle cannot be loaded. For instance, a rail car may not meet requirements and must be returned or the water is too high when the crude is checked for S&W content. In these cases, there may still need to be a ticket as there may be fees associated with the problem rail car or load. Flagging a ticket as rejected causes the volumes and mass to be set to zero, but alerts accounting that there was a ticket and that fees may be billed.
- **Calculate** - Perform calculations using the data provided and generate or resolve exceptions accordingly. This provides an opportunity to review the results of edits before the edits are actually saved. Use the Recalc. option to specify whether the existing correlation factor (CF) will be applied when calculations are performed, or if the CF itself will be recalculated using the current data.
- **Save** - Save data and perform the calculation routine, similarly to when you click Calculate. If the calculation cannot be completed due to missing data, the save will not complete and a message indicating the error will display on the lower left side of the form.
- **Delete** - Delete the selected ticket.
- **Print** - Generate a report of the ticket details. The report type will vary based on the ticket type. This button is only enabled when you are in View mode.
- **Show Revisions** - View a grid displaying the measurement values for prior revisions as well as any reversals that exist.

</div>
